set.body:
Purpose and scope
Run the generated corpus through reference and PostgreSQL scientific selection, then frozen-selection retrieval and paging. Include multiple explicit releases, history after correction and principal-specific access. Keep the query grammar and production bounds unchanged.

Acceptance proof
Both catalogs agree with independently expected membership and stored order; paging has no loss/duplication. Revoke one contributing release after freezing and verify denial of the entire selection. Historical selection membership is stable after newer releases; seed failures are reproducible with a focused command.

Start here
modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/ReferenceCatalog.scala; modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/ScientificSql.scala; modules/app/src/test/scala/sanctity/app; modules/integration/src/test/scala/sanctity/postgres

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: Q2: Check both catalogs and frozen selections against the generated query oracle
